questions.question: Against which city is the book of Nahum a prophecy?
How is the LORD described in Nahum 1?
options: Harsh and unjust toward all, punishing even the wholly innocent
Slow to anger and great in power, yet he will not clear the guilty
Quick to forgive every wrong and gentle with all of the people
Distant and ever silent, very far removed from all of human affairs
questions.answer: Slow to anger and great in power, yet he will not clear the guilty
